shared_elements: columnar/blocky body with head above torso
schematic head treated as a distinct block set on the body
incised surface detail on the head/upper zone (rows of short strokes, hatching)
suggestion of arms held against the torso
raised/rounded features on the chest area
justification: Both depict a frontal, rigidly columnar anthropomorphic figure whose block-like head sits directly on a broad torso with schematic arms brought against the body and incised/low-relief detail marking the upper zone, which is a fairly specific shared scheme of monolithic idol imagery. The strongest difference is in what fills the surfaces: A's head is essentially featureless and its torso carries abstract discs, concentric circles and horizontal bands like ornament or regalia, whereas B renders explicit modelled facial features (eyes, nose, mouth, bared teeth) and a second stacked head, with no geometric body motifs.
